title: OpenCode LSP workstation setup harness
purpose: Give low-capability agents and Windows operators one deterministic path to inspect, configure, verify, and hand off OpenCode LSP enablement without changing product code, governance, secrets, or existing OpenCode configuration.

upstreamContract.overlayStrategy: OPENCODE_CONFIG points at an AgentSwitchboard-owned machine-local overlay; existing global and project config remain untouched.
upstreamContract.stableLspRule: LSP is disabled by default; lsp=true enables built-in servers whose file types and prerequisites are present.
upstreamContract.v2Boundary: Current OpenCode V2 documentation accepts LSP configuration but does not provide an LSP runtime; fail closed on a detected v2 command/version.

safety.proofCeiling: Static/hosted validation proves harness structure and setup logic. Workstation execution can prove OpenCode command/version resolution, machine-local overlay generation, model visibility, and launch-command generation. Active LSP diagnostics require opening a supported file and observing runtime behavior.
